get.description: Return a list of all Budget Views for a project.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Direction (asc/desc) can be controlled by the presence or absence of '-' before the sort parameter

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the budget view. Use as the {budget_view_id} path parameter to retrieve its summary rows (GET /rest/v1.0/budget_views/{budget_view_id}/summary_rows) or detail rows.

name.description: Display name of the budget view, as shown in the Procore budget tool.

description.description: Free-text description of what the budget view is used for.
description.example: This is the procore standard view

created_at.description: Timestamp when the budget view was created, in ISO 8601 format.

created_by.description: User who created the budget view.

id.description: ID of the user who created the budget view.

name.description: Full name of the user who created the budget view.

login.description: Login email address of the user who created the budget view.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the budget view was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

role.description: Purpose this budget view serves, such as standard budgeting, forecasting (which exposes additional monthly forecast columns on detail rows), custom reporting, or column configuration.

links.description: URLs for retrieving budgeting data scoped to this budget view.

detail_rows.description: URL to fetch the Budget Detail Rows for this budget view.

summary_rows.description: URL to fetch the Budget Summary Rows for this budget view.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/budget_views?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
